services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Take in the beautiful Outer Banks sunset on your own private boat Duration 2 Hours About We usually depart from Miller's Waterfront restaurant in Nags Head around 6:00. From Miller's we head across the sound to Pirates Cove and then to the Manteo waterfront. We can come ashore on Banana Island then cruise back to Millers as the sun drops down low and glows. More info This experience may not be suitable for children under 4 and adults over 75. We are pet friendly to well behaved

services.name: Big Bamboo Tiki
services.desc: Spend the afternoon on your own private Tiki Hut on the water! Duration 3 Hours About We shuttle you to the Big Bamboo Tiki which includes a shaded eating area with 4 chairs. There’s a bar in the back with 2 stools and 4 bean bags. We provide 2 small coolers for beverages and food. And of course a spacious deck for sunbathing. We provide a swim ladder for easy access on and off the boat. More info This experience may not be suitable for children under 4 and adults over 75. We are pet friendly to well behaved
